title: NEET Full Mock G1
description: Extracted from official curriculum/paper. Contains 4 MCQs with comprehensive bilingual explanations.

questions.question_text: A wire of length L, area of cross section A is hanging from a fixed support. The length of the wire changes to L1 when mass M is suspended from its free end. The expression for Young's modulus is:
questions.explanation: Young's modulus Y = Stress / Strain. Stress = Force / Area = Mg / A. Strain = Change in length / Original length = (L1 - L) / L. Therefore, Y = (Mg/A) / ((L1 - L)/L) = MgL / A(L1 - L).

questions.question_text: A cylinder contains hydrogen gas at pressure of 249 kPa and temperature 27°C. Its density is: (R = 8.3 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹)
questions.explanation: Using PV = nRT, where n = mass/Molar mass (M). PV = (m/M)RT => P = (m/V) (RT/M) => P = density * (RT/M). Density = PM / RT. P = 249 * 10³ Pa, M = 2 * 10⁻³ kg/mol, T = 300 K. Density = (249 * 10³ * 2 * 10⁻³) / (8.3 * 300) = 498 / 2490 = 0.2 kg/m³.

questions.question_text: Light with an average flux of 20 W/cm² falls on a non-reflecting surface at normal incidence having surface area 20 cm². The energy received by the surface during time span of 1 minute is:
questions.explanation: Energy = Power * Time. Power = Flux * Area = 20 W/cm² * 20 cm² = 400 W. Time = 1 minute = 60 seconds. Energy = 400 * 60 = 24000 J = 24 * 10³ J.

questions.question_text: Two bodies of mass 4 kg and 6 kg are tied to the ends of a massless string. The string passes over a pulley which is frictionless (see figure). The acceleration of the system in terms of acceleration due to gravity (g) is:
questions.explanation: Acceleration a = (m2 - m1)g / (m1 + m2) = (6 - 4)g / (6 + 4) = 2g / 10 = g/5. Wait, checking the figure: 6kg - 4kg = 2kg. Total mass = 10kg. a = 2g/10 = g/5. Re-evaluating: The options provided are g/2, g/5, g/10, g. Based on standard Atwood machine, a = (6-4)g/(6+4) = 2g/10 = g/5.
